headline: Ivey signs state budgets into law
snippet: Signed $2.3B general fund for FY2021, effective October 1.

headline: Alabama Senate passes state general fund budget
snippet: $2.39B budget, $168.8M increase, priority to public safety and Corrections.

headline: Senate passes General Fund budget, stakes domain over coronavirus funds
snippet: Legislature staked claim over CARES Act spending alongside budget.
